values.task_boundary: Exactly one GCP hierarchy/cost decision register and retained redacted read-only evidence packet.
deliverables: Fresh exact-head review and closing PR
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Organization, folder, project, billing, and region are exact or explicitly blocked.
AC-2: POC and long-term ownership are explicit.
AC-3: The first workload has a hard cost ceiling.
AC-4: Quota is not treated as capacity.
AC-5: Evidence contains no credentials, secrets, raw token contents, or mutation commands.
AC-6: Fresh exact-head review has zero actionable findings and publication truth closes only issue #490.
